Here’s the version without any em dashes:  

---

**Back to the Famous Duo 💫**  

It’s just him and me again, my prince, my life, my everything. The “O Squad” is officially back in action.  

Through every season, every change, and every new beginning, it always comes back to us. The laughter, the inside jokes, the late-night talks, the little adventures that turn into lifelong memories.  

There is something so special about starting over together, not from scratch but from strength. From everything we have learned, everything we have overcome, and everything we still dream about.  

It is not always easy, but it is ours. Just us. The way it has always meant to be. 💙  

Here is to the next chapter, the duo that never quits. #OSquadForever #MyPrince #MyEverything  

---
